question: Will BTC trade above $90,000 before September 30, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BTC/USDT spot price strictly exceeds $90,000 (i.e., reaches at least $90,000.01) at any point before September 30, 2026 00:00:00 UTC, as observed on Binance, Coinbase, or CoinGecko.
- "No": Wins if the BTC/USDT spot price does not reach $90,000.01 or above at any point before September 30, 2026 00:00:00 UTC across all listed sources.

Clarifications:
- "Above $90,000" means any traded price strictly greater than $90,000 (i.e., at least $90,000.01); an exact touch of $90,000.00 does not satisfy the condition.
- The observation window runs from market open through the moment immediately before September 30, 2026 00:00:00 UTC; any confirmed trade at or above $90,000.01 within that window on any listed source resolves "Yes".
